heading: Temporal
text:
### Temporal [LSER.16.9]

| Function | Meaning | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `first(cursor)` | value of first (oldest) sample | slot type, nullable |
| `last(cursor)` | value of last (newest) sample | slot type, nullable |
| `rate(cursor)` | `(last - first) / elapsed_seconds` | `Float?` |
| `direction(cursor)` | `-1` falling, `0` steady or `+1` rising, the sign of the two newest samples' difference ([LSER.10.9]) | `Int?` |

Each is `null` exactly when the read is cold ([LSER.19.8]); `direction` is
also `null` when the window holds one sample ([LSER.10.9]), and `rate` is also
`null` when no time elapses between the window's first and last samples — a
window of one sample included — since there is no elapsed time to divide by.
